value.rationale: Exact physically natural wall-pressure *fluctuation* observables not fixed by pre-existing one-time gas pressure. The evaluated two-wall covariance reveals strictly negative force cross-correlation and opposite confinement effects on symmetric and antisymmetric modes; signed net-force large deviations are universal, total-force variance remains finite as mean occupancy vanishes, and time/volume limits provably fail to commute. This supports realistic finite-box fluctuation interpretation rather than a routine parameter exercise.
